## Durable Kernel codebase map

All durable-kernel code lives in `src/externalKernel/` (4 files) plus `package.json` contributions and a feature flag. There is **no** context/when-clause that hides the Select button after a kernel is chosen.

---

### 1. “Select Durable Kernel…” — definition & registration

**Command contribution** — `C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\package.json`

```803:808:package.json
			{
				"command": "jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.selectKernel",
				"title": "Select Durable Kernel…",
				"icon": "$(vm)",
				"category": "Durable Jupyter"
			},
```

**Activation event** (same file, ~82):

```77:83:package.json
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.start",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.stop",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.connect",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.copyUrl",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.showLog",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.selectKernel",
		"onCommand:jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.statusMenu"
```

**Command palette menu** — lines 901–905:

				},
```

				}
```

**Handler** — `C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\externalKernel\startup.ts` lines 174–213:

- Requires `activeNotebookEditor`
- Registers Durable Jupyter collection
- Auto-starts managed server if none registered
- Calls `notebook.selectKernel` with `{ notebookEditor: editor }`

**Activation wiring** — `src\extension.ts` 117–122 calls `activateExternalKernel(context)` when `isFeatureEnabled('durableKernel')`.

---

### 2. Notebook toolbar items — contribution, alignment, order

All toolbar items are under `contributes.menus["notebook/toolbar"]` (package.json 1100–1142). VS Code orders by `group` string; `@N` is relative order within that group. Alignment is the notebook top toolbar’s **execute/navigation** strip (not Left/Right status-bar alignment).

| Order key | Command | When |
|-----------|---------|------|
| `navigation/execute@5` | `showAllNotebookTags` | (none) — note: uses `"category"` not `"group"` (likely typo) |
| `navigation/execute@5` | `showAllNotebookJumpbacks` | `features.jumpbacks` |
| `navigation/execute@6` | `executeRunGroup` | none |
| `navigation/execute@7` | `showNavigationMenu` | none |
| `navigation/execute` (no @) | `jupyterEnhancements.execute` | notebook + JE feature |
| `navigation/execute@8` | `gitDiff.highlightChangedCells` | notebook + gitDiff |
| `navigation/execute@9` | `notebookFilter.set` | filter inactive |
| `navigation/execute@9` | `notebookFilter.clear` | filter active (toggle pair) |
| **`navigation/execute@10`** | **`externalKernel.selectKernel`** | **notebook + durableKernel** |

Select Durable Kernel is last among this extension’s toolbar contributions (`@10`). Filter is the only toolbar command with a show/hide toggle; durable select is not.

---

### 3. Status bar — durable kernel state

**File:** `C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\externalKernel\statusMonitor.ts`

| Concern | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Creation | `createStatusBarItem(Right, 95)` — lines 14–16 |
| Click | `command = 'jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.statusMenu'` |
| Visibility | Hidden if `manager.getServers().length === 0`; else shown |
| Poll | 5s interval when servers exist or any notebook is open (29–39) |
| Label | `` `${healthIcon} Durable ${portPart}${suffix}` `` (60) |
| Health icons | `up` → `$(server-environment)`; `down` → `$(error)`; else `$(question)` |
| Suffix | Jupyter `kernel.status` if active notebook has a kernel; else health string if not up |
| Port | From `managedServer ?? servers[0]` |
| Kernel status | Via `@vscode/jupyter-extension` `kernels.getKernel(uri)` + `onDidChangeStatus` (76–115) |
| Tooltip | label, URL, managed/connected, health, optional kernel status, “Click for Start / Stop / …” |

**Click menu** — `startup.ts` 215–255 QuickPick: Start, Connect, Stop, Copy URL, Show Log, Select Kernel… → dispatches the corresponding `externalKernel.*` commands.

---

### 4. How selection / durable state is tracked

**Persisted server state** — `DurableServerManager.ts`:

- `globalState` key `externalKernel.durableServer` (managed)
- `globalState` key `externalKernel.connectedServers` (connected list)
- In-memory: `managed`, `connected`, `lastHealth`, probe failure counts

**Context keys** — `syncContextKeys()` at 506–518:

| Context key | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.managed` | managed server record exists |
| `jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.running` | any server (managed or connected) |

Updated on initialize / start / stop / connect / disconnect / health clear.

**Not tracked:** which notebook kernel is selected, whether the active kernel is “durable,” or a “select button already used” flag. Status bar kernel text is live Jupyter API status only (`idle`/`busy`/etc.), not a durable-selection context.

**Feature gate:** `jupyter-cell-tags.features.durableKernel` (default `true`) — `src\util\featureFlags.ts` + package.json 148–152. Runtime skip in `activateExternalKernel` if disabled.

**Settings:** `externalKernel.defaultPort`, `externalKernel.autoRegisterOnNotebookOpen` (package.json 427–435).

**Kernel picker collection:** `jupyterServerCollection.ts` — id `jupyter-cell-tags.durable`, label `Durable Jupyter (survives reload)`.

---

### 5. When-clauses that hide/show the Select button after selection

**None.** Toolbar and command-palette when clauses are only:

```
notebookType == jupyter-notebook && config.jupyter-cell-tags.features.durableKernel
```

Contrast with filter’s toggle (`!jupyter-cell-tags.notebookFilter.active` / `.active`).  

`jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.managed` is used **only** for Stop in the command palette (912–914).  
`jupyter-cell-tags.externalKernel.running` is set in code but **never referenced** in `package.json` when clauses.  
`statusMenu` is hidden from palette with `"when": "false"` (932–933).

### Module file index

| Absolute path | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `...\src\externalKernel\startup.ts` | Activate, register all commands including select + status menu |
| `...\src\externalKernel\statusMonitor.ts` | Status bar label/tooltip/poll/click |
| `...\src\externalKernel\DurableServerManager.ts` | Spawn/persist/health/context keys |
| `...\src\externalKernel\jupyterServerCollection.ts` | Kernel Picker collection API |
| `...\src\util\featureFlags.ts` | `durableKernel` flag |
| `...\src\extension.ts` | Conditional activate |
| `...\package.json` | All contributes |

**Bottom line for UI work:** the Select button stays visible for every Jupyter notebook while the feature is on; server lifecycle is what contexts/`running`/`managed` reflect, not “kernel already selected.”
